description: List customer invoices with paging and a raw query filter. Revenue booked as journal entries is not listed here; use bokio_account_ledger or bokio_open_items for that.

companyId.description: Bokio company id. Defaults to BOKIO_COMPANY_ID if omitted.

query.description: Bokio filter query; combine conditions with &&, e.g. "date>=2026-07-01&&date<=2026-07-31"

name: bokio_list_invoices
